reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Photo Day Changes 004
materials.text: It is photo day. The garden is wet. The class will take the photo in the hall. The photo is at ten. Children need their blue hats. The hats stay off until the teacher says, "Hats on." After the photo, children go back to class.

questions.prompt: A friend says, "Let us go to the garden." You say, "____"
options: No, the photo is in the hall.
The photo is in our kitchen.
questions.explanation: A按花园湿而改礼堂纠正地点；B与wet相反；C厨房从未安排。

questions.prompt: A friend asks, "Is the photo at nine?" You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B纠正为十点；A沿用错误九点；C夜晚无依据。

questions.prompt: A friend has a red hat. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C要求蓝帽；A说不用帽、B说红帽均违背材料。

questions.prompt: A friend puts on a hat too soon. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A等教师说Hats on；B非回家时间；C花园没有存帽要求。

questions.prompt: The photo is over. A friend asks, "Where now?" You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B拍完回班；A湿花园、C床都不符合后续安排。

materials.title: Picnic Table Rules 004
materials.text: The class has a picnic. Eat at the big table. The small table is for bags. Wash your hands before you eat. There are apple slices for everyone. Keep the orange juice for Ben; he has no water. Put rubbish in the green bin, not the toy box.

questions.prompt: A friend starts to eat at the small table. You say, "____"
options: Let us eat at the big table.
Put your bag in the juice.
questions.explanation: A吃饭用大桌，小桌放包；B包放果汁不合理；C不是安排的用餐处。

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for food with dirty hands. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B饭前洗手；A藏食物非规则；C洗玩具箱不能解决手脏。

questions.prompt: A friend asks, "Can I have an apple slice?" You say, "____"
options: No, they are only for Ben.
No, they are for the bags.
questions.explanation: C苹果供大家；A把Ben专属果汁误套苹果；B包不会吃苹果。

questions.prompt: A friend wants Ben’s orange juice. You say, "____"
options: Please give it to the bin.
questions.explanation: A正确：Ben无水，果汁留给他；B倒垃圾桶非安排；C与无水事实相反。

questions.prompt: A friend holds an empty food bag. You say, "____"
options: Put it in the toy box.
Put it in the green bin.
Put it on the apple slices.
questions.explanation: B垃圾进绿桶；A玩具箱明确不能放；C会弄脏食物且无此安排。

materials.title: Umbrella At Home 004
materials.text: I borrow a small umbrella from my friend. It has a green handle and yellow stars. I use it on my way home. At home, I open it near the door to dry. Mum says, "Do not put it on your bed." The next day is sunny. I still take the umbrella to school because I must give it back.

questions.prompt: The umbrella belongs to the writer’s friend.
questions.explanation: A正确：从朋友借伞，说明伞归朋友；B否认借用关系。

questions.prompt: The umbrella has yellow stars.
questions.explanation: A正确：yellow stars明确图案；B与材料相反。

questions.prompt: The writer dries the umbrella on the bed.
questions.explanation: B正确：在门边撑开晾，妈妈还说不放床上；A混淆位置并忽略否定。

questions.prompt: It is raining the next day.
questions.explanation: B正确：次日sunny；A把第一天用伞延伸到次日。

questions.prompt: The writer takes the umbrella to school to return it.
questions.explanation: A正确：because I must give it back；B否认明确目的。

materials.title: Quiet Bell Game 004
materials.text: We play a quiet game in class. A little bell is in a blue cup. We pass the cup from child to child. We must not make the bell ring. Tom holds the cup with two hands. The bell is quiet. I pass it too fast, and it rings. I smile and try again slowly. Our teacher says, "There is no winner. We are learning to move carefully."

questions.prompt: The bell is inside a blue cup.
questions.explanation: A正确：in a blue cup直接给位置；B与位置事实相反。

questions.prompt: The children must make the bell ring.
questions.explanation: B正确：must not make it ring；A忽略not。

questions.prompt: Tom uses two hands to hold the cup.
questions.explanation: A正确：two hands明确；B否认操作方式。

questions.prompt: The writer tries again more slowly.
questions.explanation: A正确：try again slowly；B与第二次动作不符。

questions.prompt: The teacher gives a prize to the winner.
questions.explanation: B正确：明确There is no winner；A虚构奖品及获胜者。

materials.title: Fruit Stall Change 004
materials.text: Eva goes to the fruit stall with her dad. Apples cost six yuan a bag. They buy two bags. Dad gives the seller twenty yuan. The seller gives him a five-yuan note and three one-yuan coins. Eva counts the change. It is right. The seller asks if they want a plastic bag. They say no because they have a cloth bag. On the way home, Dad asks Eva to carry one light bag of apples. He carries the other bag and their shopping basket.

questions.prompt: How much do the two bags of apples cost?
questions.explanation: A每袋六元，两袋十二元；B只算一袋；C是付款额不是总价。

questions.prompt: How much change does Dad receive?
questions.explanation: B五元纸币加三个一元共八元；A漏硬币；C漏纸币。

questions.prompt: Why do they refuse a plastic bag?
questions.explanation: C自带布袋；A已经买苹果；B卖者主动询问非无袋。

questions.prompt: What does Eva carry on the way home?
questions.explanation: A爸爸让她提一袋轻的苹果；B另一袋和篮由爸爸提；C不是空袋。

questions.prompt: What does Eva find about the change?
questions.explanation: B原文It is right且20减12等于8；A无短款；C含硬币非全纸币。

materials.title: Museum Quiet Bags 004
materials.text: Our class visits a room of old musical instruments. The guide gives each pair of children a paper bag. Inside are two safe things to touch: a piece of wood and a piece of metal. The real instruments stay behind glass. We shake neither the bags nor the instruments. We touch the two small pieces and guess which feels colder. Then we write one word about each piece. At the end, we return the pieces to the guide but keep the paper bags for our notes.

questions.prompt: Each child gets a separate paper bag.
questions.explanation: B正确：each pair每两人一袋；A把一对误当每人。

questions.prompt: The real instruments are behind glass.
questions.explanation: A正确：真实乐器在玻璃后；B否认展示方式。

questions.prompt: Children may touch the small wood and metal pieces.
questions.explanation: A正确：袋中两件safe things to touch；B与允许体验相反。

questions.prompt: The class shakes the real instruments to hear them.
questions.explanation: B正确：neither...nor两种都不摇；A漏读否定并虚构听奏。

questions.prompt: Children keep the small metal pieces after the visit.
questions.explanation: B正确：归还物块，仅留纸袋装笔记；A混淆保留对象。

materials.title: Camera Club No Faces 004
materials.text: The camera club wants to show a school day through photographs without showing anyone’s face. Mina photographs shoes waiting outside the dance room. Leo photographs open lunch boxes, but he asks their owners first. Hana takes a picture of shadows in the playground. At first, the club plans to put the photographer’s full name below each picture. Some pupils prefer not to share their names publicly, so the club uses short chosen names. The teacher keeps a private list so pupils can still collect their own prints. The exhibition will be in the entrance hall for one week. Visitors may look at the pictures, but they must ask before copying them.

questions.prompt: The club’s photographs must show every pupil’s face.
questions.explanation: B正确：主题without showing anyone’s face；A把不露脸改成必须露脸。

questions.prompt: Leo asks permission before photographing other pupils’ lunch boxes.
questions.explanation: A正确：asks their owners first；B与先征同意相反。

questions.prompt: The exhibition uses every photographer’s full name.
questions.explanation: B正确：后来改用自选短名；A把最初方案当最终方案。

questions.prompt: The teacher keeps a private list to help pupils collect their prints.
questions.explanation: A正确：私下名单用于领回本人照片；B否认明确用途。

questions.prompt: Visitors must ask before making copies of the pictures.
questions.explanation: A正确：must ask before copying；B否认复制限制。

materials.title: Bus Shelter Library 004
materials.text:
A small book box stands beside the village bus shelter. People may take a book and bring it back when they finish. They do not have to leave another book immediately. A notebook inside records titles, not borrowers’ names. The volunteer says this makes the box easy to use, but it also means she cannot contact someone about an overdue book.
After a week of heavy rain, two books become damp. The volunteer moves the box under the shelter roof and puts a "Please close the door" note on it. The village school offers to donate a shelf. She thanks the school but asks for a smaller shelf because the first one would block the path to the bus. The box reopens on Monday with dry books and a clear path.

questions.prompt: What must a reader do after finishing a book?
options: Buy a new book for the box.
Write a full name in the notebook.
Wait for the volunteer to phone.
questions.explanation: B读完归还；A不用立即换另书；C不记姓名；D无法打电话催还。

questions.prompt: What does the notebook record?
questions.explanation: C只记录书名；A公交号码、B地址、D天气均非内容。

questions.prompt: Why was the box moved?
questions.explanation: A连雨后书潮而移到屋顶下；B不为隐藏；C要保持通道；D无出售。

questions.prompt: Why did the volunteer ask for a smaller shelf?
options: The larger one was too colourful.
The first one would block the bus path.
questions.explanation: D原架会挡去公交的路；A学校捐架不等于没书；B未提颜色；C周一重开。

questions.prompt: What is a limit of recording only titles?
options: The volunteer cannot contact a borrower about a late return.
questions.explanation: B材料说明无法联系超期借者；A使用仍自由；C无电力要求；D书已晾干。

materials.title: Garden Weather Log 004
materials.text:
The gardening club compared two tomato beds. Both received the same number of seeds from the same packet. Bed A was near a wall, while Bed B was in an open corner. Members planned to compare how many seeds grew. During the first week, a pipe leaked beside Bed A. That bed received more water even though the pupils used the same watering cans.
When more seeds grew in Bed A, one pupil said the wall must be the reason. The club leader disagreed. They had not kept water conditions the same, so the result could not show the effect of the wall alone. The group still recorded the numbers and the leak. They repaired the pipe and planned another trial. Their report included the first trial because an unexpected problem could help the next group plan more carefully.

questions.prompt: The two beds received seeds from different packets.
questions.explanation: B正确：same packet；A将相同改不同。

questions.prompt: Bed A received extra water because of a leak.
questions.explanation: A正确：管道在A旁漏水使水量更多；B否认干扰因素。

questions.prompt: The first result proved that the wall alone caused better growth.
questions.explanation: B正确：水量未保持一致，不能独断墙效果；A把相关结果当唯一因果。

questions.prompt: The group removed all mention of the first trial from its report.
questions.explanation: B正确：报告included first trial；A与保留记录相反。

questions.prompt: The group planned another trial after repairing the pipe.
questions.explanation: A正确：修管并计划重试；B否认后续行动。

materials.title: Sound Map Walk 004
materials.text:
For a neighbourhood project, pupils made a map of sounds along a walking route. They marked a fountain, a bicycle crossing and a shop door that rang when it opened. They recorded short clips on a school device. The teacher asked them to avoid recording private conversations.
At the crossing, traffic was so loud that the bicycle signal was hard to hear. Rather than move the microphone closer to a passing rider, the pupils wrote a note describing the problem. Later they asked the road office for the signal’s official timing. They added this information in a different colour so readers could tell it had not come from their own recording.
One street on the final map had no clips. It passed a health centre where people might talk about private matters. The pupils marked it "No recording here" and explained the reason. A visitor said the map looked incomplete. The teacher replied that leaving out a recording could be a thoughtful choice. The class had to show where their evidence came from and respect people along the route.

questions.prompt: Which sound was included in the pupils’ plan?
questions.explanation: B首段店门铃；A要求避开私聊；C别镇火车、D考试铃未提。

questions.prompt: What did the pupils do when traffic covered the bicycle signal?
options: They described the problem in a note.
questions.explanation: C写说明噪声问题；A未跟踪；B未伪造；D仍完成地图。

questions.prompt: Why was the road office’s information shown in another colour?
options: To distinguish an outside source from direct recordings.
To hide the route from readers.
To make the signal sound louder.
questions.explanation: A颜色标识非现场录音来源；B不是隐藏路线；C颜色不改音量；D无广告。

questions.prompt: Why were there no recordings near the health centre?
options: The pupils had lost their map.
The teacher disliked all health centres.
The group wanted to protect private conversations.
questions.explanation: D保护可能私密谈话；A没丢地图；B不是完全无声；C无教师偏见。

questions.prompt: What does the teacher’s final reply suggest?
options: A map is useful only when every sound is recorded.
A justified gap can be part of careful work.
Source information should always be removed.
questions.explanation: B有理由留白可为审慎选择；A与认可留白相反；C应标来源；D没禁止提问。
